trial_court: Family Court-II, Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati, FC(Civil) Case No. 693/2013
case_name: Rupali Dutta vs Pradip Kr. Barman
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant wife filed appeal against divorce decree granted to respondent husband in 2013. Appellant was a teacher and respondent an engineer who retired from service. Respondent alleged illicit relationship with someone from Milanpur, Chandmari.

legal_principles.principle: A court's jurisdiction must be vested in it under the law.
legal_principles.held: The respondent Commission while passing the impugned order dated 19.07.2014, had assumed jurisdiction which was not vested in it under the law.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A divorce decree should be granted only when there is an irretrievable break down of marriage.
legal_principles.held: The fact that there has been an irretrievable break down of marriage is proved from the evidence recorded by the learned Family Court.

outcome.final_order: Marriage dissolved by granting divorce decree.
